assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: ONE individual 2D fighting-game sprite animation frame for Thomas Rogan, original The House of the Dead arcade Model 2 costume, Dossier Curien. Input image 1 is the EXACT existing master rogan_guard.png; preserve this character rather than redesigning him. Produce the pre-shot WINDUP keyframe. Same young adult white male face, same swept-back copper-brown hair, same long brown knee-length overcoat and lapels with dark buttons, same pale shirt, black tie, lavender-grey waistcoat and trousers, brown leather shoes, same compact black semiautomatic pistol and two-handed grip. Same crisp finely detailed shaded 2D sprite rendering with restrained pixel-like edge detail and warm brown/grey palette; do not turn into photo/3D or a different costume. Face toward screen RIGHT. Body pose: feet remain on the same grounded locations as the master; bend both knees just slightly and settle the hips; draw the elbows closer to the ribs and hold the pistol horizontally at upper chest height, ready to extend toward the right, eyes focused straight toward the opponent. The pose should visibly anticipate the shot while keeping the gun close. Full body including entire hair, coat hems, both shoes and entire muzzle. Square 1024x1024 transparent canvas. Registration is essential: keep TOP of hair about y=55/1024 of canvas height, the ground baseline at y=960/1024, body root on x=512/1024; size and shoe placements like the reference. Do not reframe, zoom, recenter to the arm extension or add padding differently. Leave surrounding canvas truly transparent with alpha=0. One person, one pose, one pistol, two arms, two hands, no duplicate body, no extra weapon. No muzzle flash, no bullet, no smoke, no shell, no impact spark, no floor or cast shadow, no background, no black/white matte, no border, no letters, no labels, no sheet.

contact_vfx.measurement: Visual identification of front of pistol; alpha>=128 rightmost gun-column scan (x1167..1172, y211..248) confirms muzzle-face span. Point uses outside-right x1173 and centre y230; visual estimate uncertainty ±8 source px. No muzzle flash baked into art.

qa.method: PNG IHDR parsed, full DEFLATE inflate + PNG unfilter, alpha distribution and alpha>=16 bounding boxes measured in JavaScript. SHA256 known-answer abc passed and guard hash matches catalogue.
qa.coordinate_convention: bounding boxes are [x0,y0,x1_exclusive,y1_exclusive] in source pixels
qa.dimensions_note: Requested1024x1024; generator returned1254x1254 consistently. Preserve original files; use proportional registration in renderer.
qa.alpha_note: There are tiny alpha residuals below16 outside the visible silhouettes, including at canvas edges; alpha>=16 excludes this noise. No opaque matte is present.
qa.visual_review: One full-body sprite per image; correct brown coat/waistcoat/trousers/shoes and two-handed black pistol. Windup elbows tucked, contact fully extended, recovery partly retracted, recoil upper-body hit reaction. No flash, smoke, gore, floor or duplicate figures.
